lines.text: Sand Hill Road. Every firm that funded Overclass has an office here, and they all smell like cold brew and fear.
lines.spoken: Sand Hill Road. Every firm that funded Overclass has an office here, and they all smell like cold brew and fear.

lines.text: Lance Upround at Down Round Capital holds the access keys to Overclass's campus. He is not going to hand them over.
lines.spoken: Lance Upround at Down Round Capital holds the access keys to Overclass's campus. He is not going to hand them over.

lines.text: Let me stop you right there. We don't take cold pitches. Have you tried getting a warm intro from someone who doesn't exist?
lines.spoken: Let me stop you right there. We don't take cold pitches. Have you tried getting a warm intro, from someone who doesn't exist?

lines.text: Fight through the office park and take the keys from Upround. He fights like he negotiates: dirty, and with a lot of associates.
lines.spoken: Fight through the office park, and take the keys from Upround. He fights like he negotiates. Dirty, and with a lot of associates.
